sections.title: Personal income tax (daň z príjmov fyzických osôb, § 15)

source.title: Finančná správa (podpora): Výpočet preddavkov na daň – sadzba dane; Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), § 15 písm. a) prvý bod and § 52zzzj

sections.basis: Tax base (základ dane) from employment and business income, per year
sections.note: New for 2026: four rates instead of two. The thresholds are 154.8×, 212.4×, 264× the subsistence minimum valid on 1 January (€284.13); monthly withholding uses a twelfth of each threshold (€3,665.28, €5,029.10, €6,250.86). Self-employed people with business income up to €100,000 pay 15% instead.

rows.note: the base for every income tax threshold

Full amount for a tax base up to (91.8×)
Above that base

rows.value: Only against employment and business income; not available to people who already receive an old-age or early-retirement pension above the allowance on 1 January

rows.value: €20,116.40 (70.8×) minus one third of the tax base, less the spouse's own income

rows.label: Spouse: conditions
rows.value: Spouse lives in the household and cared for a dependent minor child, received the care allowance, was a registered jobseeker or has a disability; claimed after the end of the year, pro rata by month

sections.note: The bonus is claimed per dependent child living in the household against employment or business income; it can exceed the tax and is then paid out. Only one parent claims it.
